fullPassage: To determine the mass of my bowling ball, I might put it onto a balance and compare it with a known mass, such as a number of metal cubes each weighing 1, 10, or 100 grams. Things get much more complicated if I want to know the mass of a distant star. How do I measure it? We can roughly say that measuring the mass of a star involves various theories. If we want to measure the mass of a binary star, we first determine a center of mass between the two stars, then their distance from that center which we can then use, together with a value for the period and a certain instance of Kepler‘s Third Law, to calculate the mass. In other words, in order to “measure” the star mass, we measure other quantities and use those values, together with certain equations, to calculate the mass. Measurement is not a simple and unmediated estimation of independently existing properties, but a determination of certain magnitudes before the background of a number of accepted theories.

questions.passage: Measurement is not a simple and __________ (mediate) estimation of independently existing properties, but a determination of certain magnitudes.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 측정은 독립적으로 존재하는 속성에 대한 단순하고 매개되지 않은 추정이 아니다.
det.analysis: simple and _____ estimation → 형용사 자리. 원문은 unmediated(매개되지 않은). un- 접두사 + 과거분사 형태.

questions.passage: To determine the mass of my bowling ball, I might put it onto a balance and compare it with a known mass, such as a number of metal cubes each weighing 1, 10, or 100 grams. Things get much more complicated if I want to know the mass of a distant star. How do I measure it? We can roughly say that measuring the mass of a star involves various theories. If we want to measure the mass of a binary star, we first determine a center of mass between the two stars, then their distance from that center which we can then use, together with a value for the period and a certain instance of Kepler‘s Third Law, to calculate the mass. In other words, in order to “measure” the star mass, we measure other quantities and use those values, together with __________, to calculate the mass. Measurement is not a simple and unmediated estimation of independently existing properties, but a determination of certain magnitudes before the background of a number of accepted theories.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 별의 질량을 측정하기 위해 다른 양들의 값을 '특정 방정식'과 함께 사용한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① metal cubes — 금속 큐브 (볼링공 측정 맥락)
❌ ② various theories — 다양한 이론 (앞 문장에서 이미 사용)
✅ ③ certain equations — 특정 방정식 ←정답
❌ ④ other quantities — 다른 양 (앞에서 이미 측정 대상으로 언급)
det.tip: together with certain equations = 특정 방정식과 함께

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 측정은 다수의 '수용된 이론'을 배경으로 이루어지는 특정 규모의 결정이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① existing properties — 존재하는 속성 (앞 절에서 부정된 내용)
❌ ② certain magnitudes — 특정 규모 (같은 절 내 중복)
❌ ③ binary stars — 쌍성 (일반적 측정론에 부적합)
✅ ④ accepted theories — 수용된 이론 ←정답
det.tip: before the background of accepted theories = 수용된 이론을 배경으로
